title: Women’s night robe
desc: A cast metal moth necklace inspired by the moth’s fearless instinct to follow light. The piece reflects the delicate but bold nature of pursuing one’s impulses — even when the path feels uncertain. Its clean cast form preserves the symbolic simplicity of the moth while carrying a quiet strength.
notes: The pendant design is original and created exclusively for PublicPixels.
Produced through a custom metal casting process, ensuring durability and a refined finish.
Chain length generally sits around the collarbone.
material: Cast metal alloy pendant with a fine lightweight chain.
shipping: This item is made to order through a casting studio. Production may take 2–3 weeks, and delivery time varies by location. Please allow up to 4 weeks in total.
care: Keep away from moisture and chemicals. Wipe gently after wear and store in a dry place to maintain the finish.
